exposure: Embryo quality on day 3 (poor, good, top)
cohort: Patients who underwent in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer procedures, divided into groups based on the quality of embryos on day 3 from which the transferred blastocyst originated.
finding: Transferring frozen-thawed blastocysts developed from poor-quality cleavage stage embryos resulted in a higher miscarriage rate compared to blastocysts from top-quality embryos, although clinical pregnancy rates and live birth rates were similar.
